properties.answer: Approved (Anthony, 2026-07-25). Take on the upstream change: expose RocksDB's secondary/read-only open in dynograph-storage so a session without the write lock can still read the design. The fleet's real blocker, and the only item on the list that cannot be fixed inside this repo.
properties.context_setter: Nothing satisfies requirement “Reading the design does not require owning it”
properties.question: Should a session that cannot get the write lock still be able to READ the design — orientation, reports, gap checks — instead of having no design brain at all? This is the fleet's real blocker: five of your six sessions get nothing today. The catch is that it cannot be fixed here; it needs a change to the storage library reflow2 depends on, which you own but which is pinned by version. Do you want that upstream change taken on?
